limitations: No cold-cache or physical SSD/PCIe bandwidth claim; loaded and copy bytes are logical payload accounting.
Geometry ready is CPU observation of a completed upload receipt, not actual draw/CLAS/RT consumption.
Admission cohorts may be split across frames by workers and upload budget. Policy does not wait to fill a batch.
Rolling rates use actual elapsed time, about 1 second; idle windows decay to zero. Activity-only distributions exclude zero-speed frames and are not whole-replay averages.
Other desktop GPU applications remain active; per-process monitor CSVs retained.
First 300 frames excluded from frame distributions; first-frame DLSS initialization still affects initial demand latency.
After successful report and terminal GoogleTest teardown, replay helper cleans up Streamline process after eight-second teardown grace period.
